name: tests-75pct-pendulum-exact-nanosecond-temporal-values
instr:
Add exact nanosecond DateTime and Duration values. Preserve existing behaviour.

Datetime nanosecond construction accepts 0..999999999, exposes that fraction and microsecond=nanosecond//1000, and raises ValueError outside the range. from_timestamp_ns and int_timestamp_ns round-trip signed integer epochs. Named/fixed-offset conversion preserves exact instants and fractions; named-zone attachment preserves the requested fold and fraction. Submicrosecond instants compare/order distinctly; equivalent zoned instants compare/hash equally. replace(), shallow copy and pickle retain fraction, timezone and fold.

Nanosecond addition/subtraction carries across seconds and negative epochs, advancing exact elapsed instants through Paris spring gaps and autumn repeats. Calendar month addition clamps month-end while retaining fractions; calendar day addition preserves wall-clock fields/fractions across transitions.

Duration combines seconds, microseconds and signed nanoseconds into exact totals; nanoseconds exposes the combined fractional component. Duration addition matches direct nanosecond addition and negative durations reverse without loss. Intervals include exact endpoints, exclude values outside them and report elapsed nanosecond totals across transitions.

Parse right-pads one-, six-, eight- and nine-digit fractions. Python/native modes retain nine-digit UTC fractions and agree on calendar/week/offset timestamps and UTC/Paris conversion. Both retain nine-digit ISO durations and agr
